<?php
/**
 * Generate 150 test posts with predictable titles for testing search functionality.
 * This helps test the search functionality in post include/exclude controls.
 */
for ( $i = 1; $i <= 150; $i++ ) {
	// Create a mix of different title patterns
	if ( $i <= 50 ) {
		$title = 'Apple Post ' . str_pad( $i, 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT );
	} elseif ( $i <= 100 ) {
		$title = 'Banana Article ' . str_pad( $i, 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT );
	} else {
		$title = 'Cherry Story ' . str_pad( $i, 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT );
	}

	wp_insert_post( array(
		'post_title'   => $title,
		'post_content' => 'This is test post content for ' . $title . '. It contains some sample text to make the post more realistic.',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_type'    => 'post',
	) );
}

echo '150 test posts created successfully.';
?>
